ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 25% coverage of high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ubiquitous distribution of high-contrast white annular and circular geometric blobs across both lobes, with higher cluster density concentrated in the medial region adjacent to the central notch and tapering towards the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude micro-serrations along the primary boundary, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular clusters and protrusions at the terminal distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curve trajectory following a symmetrical parabolic arc from the medial notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme high-density spatial distribution of high-contrast white-on-black annular rings and circular clusters (varying in radii from 5-15 pixels) across the entire visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Terminal points of both lobes exhibit significant irregular pixel clusters and jagged boundary variations extending beyond the primary fluke contour, suggesting localized mass accumulation or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'ring-like' annular patterning accounts for the majority of surface pigmentation variation, creating a highly textured visual appearance.
